description: This file defines the NotesRepo class, which acts as a data access layer for note-related operations in the database. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes, as well as managing tags, pinned status, and favorites.

classes.name: NotesRepo
classes.description: Repository class providing an interface for note operations scoped per user.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a database session.

methods.name: Note create(self, user_id: int, title: str, content: str, tags: list[Tag])
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified user, title, content, and tags.

methods.name: Note|None get_for_user(self, user_id: int, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note for a user by note ID.

methods.name: tuple[list[Note],int] list_for_user( self, user_id: int, limit: int, offset: int, tag_id: int | None = None, pinned: bool | None = None, favorite: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Lists notes for a user with optional filtering by tag, pinned, or favorite, with pagination.

methods.name: tuple[list[Note],int] search_for_user(self, user_id: int, query: str, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Searches notes for a user based on a text query, with pagination.

methods.name: Note update_fields(self, note: Note, title: str | None, content: str | None)
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of a note.

methods.name: Note replace_tags(self, note: Note, tags: list[Tag])
methods.description: Replaces all tags of a note with a new list.

methods.name: Note set_pinned(self, note: Note, value: bool)
methods.description: Sets the pinned status of a note.

methods.name: Note set_favorite(self, note: Note, value: bool)
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a note.
